'''Joy''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Korbin]]. Like other cities on the planet, such as [[Pleasant City]], [[Happy]], and [[Peace]], it was controlled by criminals who gave it its name, though conditions were not as severe as in Pleasant City. Because of this and its small size, Joy was known as a Small-Timer.<ref name="PoG2" />
